title: The Voyage of the Dawn Treader
author: C. S. Lewis
summary: Edmund, Lucy and their cousin Eustace are pulled into Narnia and join Prince Caspian on a sea voyage to find seven lost lords. Each island brings a new danger or wonder.
readIf: you like episodic sea voyages and classic children's fantasy.
skipIf: you want complex plotting or a story without Christian allegory.
